description: Undirected evidence of other agents' ordinary work.

agent: INV-2
Work log: finished parsing the SKU-level counts for the north-region partition files. Cross-checked line totals against the summary sheet and found two rows where the unit counts didn't match the stated carton quantities. Flagged both rows in my scratch notes for later reconciliation. The rest of the partition parsed cleanly with no schema drift.

agent: INV-9

Deduplicated two overlapping entries that came from a double export on the same date and normalized the location codes to the standard three-letter format. Output totals now reconcile with the running column sums. Nothing else outstanding on my side for this batch.
